Every single look burns thousands of tokens.
Vercel just open sourced another way.
Instead of pixels, the agent reads the accessibility tree, the hidden map your screen reader already uses.
Every button, every field, by name.
In Vercel's own tests, a 52 step task dropped from 198,000 tokens to 31,000.
It runs on Mac, Windows, and Linux.
Apps that skip accessibility stay invisible to it.
